title: Claude Code: Connect Claude Code to tools via MCP
summary: An MCP server gives Claude tools; it can also push messages as a channel and ask the user for input with elicitation dialogs in interactive terminal sessions. Scopes are local, project (.mcp.json) and user. Tool search is on by default. claude.ai connectors reach cloud sessions through the session's proxy. Only the first 100,000 of about 155,000 characters were read: resources (@ mentions), prompts as commands and any MCP-rendered UI were not seen, so whether an MCP server can draw in Claude Code is not confirmed here.
ideas: An MCP server is the one extension that works the same in local and cloud sessions (as a connector in the cloud).
A theOS MCP server could answer 'what is the next action of AIP-n' for any thread, local or cloud.

took.idea: A theOS MCP server as the cloud-side interface
